label: Motor
description: Rotating equipment (motor/pump/fan) with run/stop command, running feedback, optional analog speed feedback with a HiHi overspeed alarm, and an optional drive fault input.

questionnaire.name: opc_server
questionnaire.description: OPC UA connection name configured in the Gateway.

questionnaire.name: device_path
questionnaire.description: OPC device path root for this motor instance, e.g. '[default]PLC1/Motors/M101'.

questionnaire.name: has_speed_feedback
questionnaire.description: Does the motor report an analog speed/RPM feedback signal?

questionnaire.name: speed_eng_unit
questionnaire.description: Engineering unit for the speed member (used only if has_speed_feedback).

questionnaire.name: speed_eng_low
questionnaire.description: Speed member engineering range low (used only if has_speed_feedback).

questionnaire.name: speed_eng_high
questionnaire.description: Speed member engineering range high (used only if has_speed_feedback).

questionnaire.name: high_speed_setpoint
questionnaire.description: HiHi (overspeed) alarm setpoint for speed, exposed as a UDT parameter so it can be tuned per instance (used only if has_speed_feedback).

questionnaire.name: speed_alarm_deadband
questionnaire.description: Deadband for the overspeed alarm, in the same engineering units as speed (used only if has_speed_feedback).

questionnaire.name: enable_speed_history
questionnaire.description: Enable tag history on the speed member. Deliberate opt-in per the history convention — not enabled by default.

questionnaire.name: speed_history_deadband
questionnaire.description: Historical deadband for speed, in RPM (used only if enable_speed_history).

questionnaire.name: has_fault_input
questionnaire.description: Does the motor drive/starter report a fault/trip status?
